title: HPACK: Header Compression for HTTP/2
summary: Defines HPACK, the compression format for HTTP header fields used by HTTP/2. It uses a static table, a dynamic table of recently seen fields and Huffman coding to shrink repeated headers, while avoiding the compression-based attacks that affected earlier approaches.

eli5.summary: Instead of writing the same long address on every letter, you agree on short code numbers for things you say often. Letters get smaller and travel faster.
